explanation: The race rewards endurance as much as speed. Teams of drivers take turns at the wheel, and the winning car is the one that covers the greatest distance in the 24 hours.

claims.text: The 24 Hours of Le Mans motor race, first run in 1923, is named after the French city of Le Mans, where it is held.
Reims, Dijon and Pau do not give their names to a 24-hour motor race.
At Le Mans, several drivers share each car, taking turns at the wheel.
The winning car at Le Mans is the one that covers the greatest distance in 24 hours.
